standard_prerequisites.name: Standard interactive proof composition and amplification; cited uniform low-depth and polynomial-evaluation proximity proof protocols

core_obligations: Analyze distance preservation and soundness of the polynomial folding reduction under dispersed distributions.
Compose repeated folding with low-depth polynomial evaluation and establish the final complexity bounds.
difficulty_reason: Uses polynomial folding under a hybrid distribution/uniform metric, with dispersion-dependent preservation of distance and a low-depth-to-polynomial-evaluation reduction. All three deferred claim proofs and the main dispersed-distribution proof from the appendices are retained.

dedup.scope: Root exclusive-source allocation checked complete legacy, preparation and two active lines without a DOI hit. Separate principal claims cover general NC, symmetric separation, relaxed correction, dispersed distributions and white-box product distributions. The dispersed and product-distribution protocols have distinct assumptions and constructions; intermediate folding, learning and granularisation lemmas are uncounted. Root refreshes aliases before upload.
